title: Fictional Hack Office Emergency Action Plan (exercise only)
disclaimer: Fictional plan for a fictional office used in a simulation exercise. Not a real building's plan, not compliance advice, not certified training. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Red Hat or NVIDIA.

reporting.text: Anyone who sees fire, smoke or a blocked route reports it right away with notify, citing the evidence ID of what they saw (e.g. E1) and the zone. Recipient 'all' is the building's simulated alarm/announcement. Fire: alert everyone and evacuate to the assembly point. Blocked route: tell everyone who might use that route, then re-plan. No real emergency call is made in this exercise. Questions about the plan go to the warden, Alex.

routes.text: Two ground-level exits; both lead outside to the assembly point in the south plaza. From the Red Hat room the primary route is door_b -> lobby -> south_branch -> east_exit -> plaza -> assembly. Alternate: door_a -> north_corridor -> west_exit -> west_sidewalk -> plaza -> assembly. From the lobby, the alternate is connector -> north_corridor -> west_exit. Never route through a known fire or blocked zone; if a route is reported blocked, plan a new route before moving. Exit doors open from inside without keys. All doors and corridors on these routes are wide enough for a wheelchair.

assistance.text: Visitors who may need help agree a buddy in advance. The warden, Alex, is the designated buddy for Daniel (visitor, uses a wheelchair) if Daniel asks for it; Daniel's current preference is in the briefing. Consent first: Daniel asks with request_assistance, Alex goes to him (next to him), then assist links them and they move together on accessible tiles. Nobody carries or lifts Daniel; he moves himself. If Daniel prefers to go independently, he evacuates on accessible routes and is still accounted for.

accountability.text: Everyone goes to the assembly point (yellow area with the flag in the south plaza) and checks in there with check_in; check-in only counts when physically inside the assembly area. After checking in, the warden, Alex, runs verify_roster: Alex, Maya and Daniel must all be checked in and any agreed assistance completed. Only the roster verification confirms the exercise complete. Outstanding people are reported, never assumed safe.
